notes: Governing documents in force on the reference date: GR X (effective 5/8/2015), the Provost's Faculty TDL policy (revised November 2009) and HR 88.0 (revised 2015-03-25). The HR FAQ (2018_00, undated, captured 2019) is a summary; it adds nothing coded here that the governing documents lack, and for faculty pay it defers to the faculty regulations.

No dedicated paid parental leave, modified-duties or teaching-relief provision appears in any source. The birth parent's paid time comes from faculty Temporary Disability Leave (employer-funded; faculty accrue no sick bank): childbearing leave 'usually do not exceed 30 working days or six calendar weeks' (c3, V1), within the six-month TDL entitlement (c1 leave, c2 pay; U6).

Open structure question: c2 (generic TDL pay, six months) and c3 (childbearing TDL, up to six weeks) both sit within c1. c3 is the childbirth-specific application of the same pay; c2 is kept for disability beyond the childbearing period. If the derivation's V6 generic-plan figure should use the stated childbirth period rather than the six-month plan maximum, c2 may need to be read with c3.

Not components (purpose-specific leaves a parent could not take for a birth): sabbatical leave, educational leave, scholarly fellowship leave, entrepreneurial leave, leave for an election or term of office (GR X.B.2.d(1),(5)-(7), X.B.3.b). The FMLA intermittent or reduced-schedule option for childbirth is recorded in c4, not as a part-time option.
Calendar: GR X refers to semesters ('fall semester', 'academic semester') without a length; calendar.kind = semester, and the term length follows R8's order.

Chain, birth parent: TDL leave 6 months (c1) containing childbearing TDL pay up to 6 weeks (c3) and the generic TDL pay plan (c2); FMLA 12 workweeks concurrent with c1 from its start (c4); LTD (c6) only after six months of TDL.
Chain, non-birth parent: FMLA 12 workweeks (c4), with family-care TDL pay up to 30 days within it (c5).
